campaign.scope: Continuous native campaign from New Game. Fixed-step movement and door interaction through authored geometry. Actual Playwright E for bell and exits, Space for chapter cards. Bosses receive a seeded terminal hit through native damage. Hostile attacks are isolated during this route.

nativeFormatting.scope: Node VM executes exact native L6, B6, fk, h9 from the frozen HTML and the whole existing chapter-record module with only DOM/storage/timer boundaries stubbed.

arsenal.scope: Real R/digit keys, mouse fire/kick and RAF. Isolated setup inventories; no gameplay balance claim. Same-build cache ghost comparison, not old visual parity.

display.scope: Native resize/graphics handlers; actual R for two representatives, fixed-pose display/cache checks separately. No FPS claim.
